gen-press-start-2p-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri rises on a skyward x-height, its rounded letters staying open and friendly. Kedebideri sits beside Press Start 2P and softens its widely spaced, retro lettering with rounder, friendlier shapes.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-khula: Khula reads modern and level-headed, with a tall midsection and curves that hold their mouths open. Khula handles sustained text, while Press Start 2P is best at announcing itself with widely spaced, retro letters.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-krub: Retro and playful, Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, while Krub stands tall with a pronounced x-height. Krub keeps a contemporary hush under all that retro fun.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-kufam: Clean and contemporary, Kufam draws every letter like a neon tube, with generously open curves. Kufam does best with its pipe-cleaner uniformity, while Press Start 2P does best at wide-spaced, retro display lettering.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-lexend: Lexend is an approachable sans with outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, drawn as if with one pen tip. Press Start 2P adds the retro, far-apart fun on top.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-lexend-deca: Approachable and clean, Lexend Deca draws an unshaded line, with big lowercase beside small-looking capitals. Yet the best part is Press Start 2P, its worn felt-marker swell playing against zero contrast.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mada: Mada is an approachable sans with a towering midzone. Its curves refuse to close, so paragraphs set under Press Start 2P keep a modern, open feel from line to line.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-martel-sans: Retro and playful, Press Start 2P leads with a mild shimmer of weight changes across the words. Martel Sans, a plain sans with a high mean line, keeps text feeling open all the way down the page.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-matangi: Contemporary and hefty, Matangi has strokes like pressed twine. The best quality here is two kinds of sturdiness: Press Start 2P with curves that never turn spindly, Matangi with one constant stroke width.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-maven-pro: Modern and level, Maven Pro keeps a gentle monotone line. What stands out is how Press Start 2P, with middle-of-the-road contrast, sits against vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight.
